# Eclipse Timekeeping

> Eclipse Systems sells Eclipse Timekeeping, Mission Command by Eclipse, Eclipse project billing, and Eclipse Suite for small businesses, law firms, and shift-based teams in the United States. Eclipse Suite includes the three non-legal products; Eclipse Legal is a specialized add-on for law firms.

## Product
- [Pricing](https://eclipsesystems.pro/pricing): Product, bundle, and add-on prices.
- [Eclipse Timekeeping ($10/seat/mo)](https://eclipsesystems.pro/plans/timekeeping): Personal and team time tracking.
- [Mission Command by Eclipse ($18/seat/mo)](https://eclipsesystems.pro/plans/mission-command): Shifts, swaps, team chat, and operational approvals.
- [Eclipse ($22/seat/mo)](https://eclipsesystems.pro/plans/eclipse): Clients, projects, tasks, and invoicing.
- [Eclipse Suite ($38/seat/mo)](https://eclipsesystems.pro/plans/suite): Timekeeping, Mission Command, and Eclipse project billing together.
- [Eclipse Legal Add-on ($20/seat/mo)](https://eclipsesystems.pro/plans/legal-addon): ABA UTBMS codes, LEDES 1998B export, matters, trust accounting.
